meta.intensity_reason: France PA mandate under 90 days away - 100+ PAs certified - certified-vs-not gap visible by September - Pennylane EUR 175M war chest + AI co-pilot - Cegid in integration mode after Shine
meta.ifyrne: Pennylane's substantial €175M funding and aggressive EU expansion, including Spain, directly threaten Sage Active's market entry and position against competitors like Cegid, who are also increasing their sales force in Germany. While the Spanish Verifactu deadline's postponement to 2027 offers a critical window, the French PA mandate in September 2026 requires immediate acceleration of customer onboarding for Sage Active and AutoEntry+AKAO to avoid significant fines for our clients. Germany's XRechnung mandate in January 2028 necessitates a clear product strategy and development roadmap now, especially given Cegid's targeted outreach to German practices. The most critical action this week is to finalize the GE-Active sync resolution to enable a seamless product offering ahead of these looming deadlines.
meta.last_scan_summary: Manual deep refresh - data current as of 3 June 2026

summaries.FR: The French market shows high activity with competitors solidifying their positions ahead of the September 2026 e-invoicing mandate, and regulatory bodies providing clear readiness updates.
summaries.ES: Market signals for Spain show a strong focus on Verifactu compliance, with competitors actively promoting their readiness and regulatory deadlines approaching.
summaries.PT: Recent market signals for Portugal indicate a significant competitive push from Cegid following its acquisition of PHC, alongside upcoming regulatory deadlines for Qualified Electronic Signatures and SAF-T accounting files.
summaries.Pennylane: Pennylane is aggressively expanding across Europe, particularly in Germany, and heavily investing in AI features, posing a significant competitive threat to Sage WiSE.

signals.title: Pennylane launches in Germany, targeting 100 hires
signals.body: Pennylane has officially launched in Germany, its first overseas market, with plans to hire 100 local staff. The company aims to modernize the German accounting sector, which is considered complex and slow to digitalize, positioning itself against established players like DATEV.
signals.implication: Pennylane's entry into the German market, a key territory for Sage WiSE, presents a direct competitive threat. Sage needs to monitor Pennylane's traction and adapt its strategy for the German market, especially given Pennylane's stated intention to challenge DATEV.

signals.title: Pennylane secures €175M for European expansion and AI development
signals.body: Pennylane has raised €175 million in a Series E funding round led by TCV and Blackstone Growth. The capital will be used to expand its presence across Europe, enhance R&D with a focus on AI tools for accountants, and upgrade its payments and cash management systems. The company's valuation has reached €3.5 billion.
signals.implication: Significant capital injection for Pennylane will accelerate its competitive threat across Europe, particularly in AI-driven features and market expansion, requiring Sage WiSE to reassess its own R&D and market entry strategies.
signals.source: Vestbee, Maddyness UK, MEXC News, EU-Startups, FinTech Futures, GlobalData, TNW, Tech.eu, Sifted (Jan 2026)

signals.title: Contasol (Software DELSOL) Highlights Verifactu Compliance in 2026 Updates
signals.body: Contasol, a Spanish accounting software from Software DELSOL, is being updated to be compliant with Spain's 2026 fiscal regulations, including Verifactu and electronic invoicing. The software is promoted as being adapted to the Verifactu norm and is available with a free version for one user, targeting SMEs and freelancers.
signals.implication: Contasol's established presence and free tier could attract a significant segment of the Spanish market, particularly freelancers and small businesses. Sage Active needs to differentiate its offering, potentially through advanced features or superior integration capabilities, to compete effectively.
signals.source: Contasol and Software DELSOL websites, updated through 2026

signals.title: France's e-invoicing mandate: All businesses must be ready to receive by Sept 1, 2026
signals.body: As of September 1, 2026, all VAT-registered companies in France must be capable of receiving compliant electronic invoices. The central directory for invoice reception is now open, and companies need to register their reception address before the September deadline.
signals.implication: This regulatory deadline is fast approaching, and any delays or unresolved issues with Sage's e-invoicing capabilities could put them at a disadvantage compared to competitors who are fully compliant and certified.
signals.source: 1er septembre 2026 : ce qui change pour les factures reçues (June 19 2026)

signals.title: Cegid in exclusive negotiations to acquire EBP, aiming for European leadership
signals.body: Cegid has entered into exclusive negotiations to acquire EBP, a move that would create a major European player in management software for SMEs. This acquisition, if completed, would significantly strengthen Cegid's position in the French market, particularly with EBP's existing base of 275,000 users.
signals.implication: The potential Cegid-EBP merger could create a formidable competitor in France, impacting Sage's market share, especially if they combine their sales efforts and product offerings.
signals.source: EBP, A Cegid Company - CJEC (Accessed June 20, 2026)

signals.title: 107 Platforms Accredited for French E-Invoicing Mandate by Sept 2026
signals.body: As of May 2026, 107 platforms have been accredited by the DGFiP for the upcoming French e-invoicing mandate, effective September 1, 2026. This accreditation is crucial for businesses to transmit and receive electronic invoices. The list of accredited platforms is regularly updated on impots.gouv.fr.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are either accredited or integrate seamlessly with accredited platforms to meet the September 2026 deadline for French businesses. Competitors like Pennylane and Cegid are actively positioning themselves as accredited platforms.

signals.title: Holded achieves Verifactu certification
signals.body: Holded has announced that its invoicing software is Verifactu-certified and ready for the July 1, 2026, mandatory compliance date for businesses using certified invoicing software. Holded is listed on the AEAT's registry of certified software.
signals.implication: Holded's early certification and clear communication about Verifactu compliance could attract businesses seeking a compliant solution, potentially impacting Sage Active's market position.

signals.title: Sage Active Spain enhances AI capabilities for accounting and treasury
signals.body: Sage Active in Spain is actively enhancing its AI capabilities, including Sage Copilot for task automation and insights, and features for treasury management and tax compliance (Verifactu). A demo in April 2026 showcased features like AI-powered accounting automation, treasury control, and Verifactu compliance management.
signals.implication: While Sage is investing in AI for Sage Active in Spain, the competitive landscape is also advancing rapidly. Continuous innovation and clear communication of these AI benefits will be crucial to differentiate against competitors and meet the evolving needs of Spanish SMEs and accountants.

signals.title: Spain's Verifactu invoicing compliance deadlines set for Jan/Jul 2027
signals.body: The mandatory compliance deadline for Spain's Verifactu invoicing system has been confirmed for January 1, 2027, for corporate income taxpayers, and July 1, 2027, for all other obligated taxpayers, including self-employed professionals. This system requires invoicing software to generate traceable, tamper-evident invoice records and is part of Spain's anti-fraud measures.
signals.implication: This regulatory deadline is a critical compliance requirement for Sage Active (ES). Ensuring SfA and Sage Active are Verifactu-compliant by these dates is essential to avoid penalties and maintain market position. Competitors like Holded are already highlighting their compliance.
signals.source: Holded, AEAT, KPMG, Sovos, Global VAT Compliance, Taxually, Avalara (Various dates in 2025-2026)

signals.title: Cegid strengthens French market presence with EBP acquisition and sales expansion.
signals.body: Cegid, already a European leader in management software, is in exclusive negotiations to acquire EBP, a major player in the French SMB software market. This move, coupled with Cegid's plan to hire 100 new sales representatives in France for Q2 2026, signals a significant push into the French market, particularly targeting TPE/PME and the expert-comptable channel.
signals.implication: This aggressive expansion by Cegid/EBP could intensify competition for Sage's offerings in France, especially if they target the same accounting practices and SMBs.
signals.source: EBP, A Cegid Company - CJEC (Accessed June 18 2026), Cegid x EBP - La profession comptable (April 23 2024)

signals.title: Pennylane is a certified platform for France's September 2026 e-invoicing mandate.
signals.body: Pennylane has officially obtained the status of Plateforme Agréée (PA) for the mandatory electronic invoicing, effective September 2026. This certification allows them to handle electronic invoicing and e-reporting requirements for businesses in France.
signals.implication: Pennylane is well-positioned to capture market share from accountants and businesses preparing for the mandate, potentially impacting Sage's SfA and Active offerings in France.
signals.source: Pennylane Avis 2026: verdict cabinet utilisateur - Earn (February 26 2026)

signals.title: Holded actively promotes Verifactu compliance for accounting firms
signals.body: Holded is actively marketing its Verifactu-compliant software to accounting firms in Spain, emphasizing its readiness for the upcoming regulatory changes. They highlight features like draft invoices, invoice cancellation, and event logs to ensure compliance.
signals.implication: Monitor Holded's market penetration and customer acquisition in the Spanish 'despachos' channel, as their Verifactu readiness could attract firms seeking compliant solutions.

signals.title: Pennylane poised for Spain entry in H2 2026, intensifying competition
signals.body: Pennylane, a French fintech unicorn, has secured significant funding and is expanding across Europe. While specific launch dates for Spain are not yet public, their H2 2026 target for Spain indicates a strong competitive push into the market.
signals.implication: Sage must accelerate its Spain strategy for Sage for Accountants (SfA) to gain market share before Pennylane's entry and solidify its position against this well-funded competitor.

signals.title: Verifactu deadlines confirmed for Jan 2027 (companies) and Jul 2027 (self-employed)
signals.body: The Verifactu invoicing system deadlines have been clarified, with companies needing to comply by January 1, 2027, and self-employed individuals by July 1, 2027. Software providers were required to adapt their systems by July 29, 2025.
signals.implication: Sage Active Spain must ensure full Verifactu compliance for both corporate and autónomo segments by the respective deadlines to avoid penalties for users and maintain market competitiveness.
signals.source: Holded, Contasimple, Datisa ERP, Properly, Verifactu AEAT, Avalara May 2026

signals.title: Sage Active integrates a "Plateforme agréée" for electronic invoicing compliance.
signals.body: Sage Active now includes a "Plateforme agréée" (approved platform) natively integrated to simplify the transition to electronic invoicing. This feature is designed to ensure compliance with upcoming regulations, with a mention of "e-invoicing" and "e-reporting" requirements. Sage Active also leverages AI for automated invoice data entry.
signals.implication: Sage is actively preparing its Sage Active product for the French e-invoicing mandate, positioning it as a compliant solution. This is a positive development for Sage's offering in France, addressing a key regulatory requirement.
signals.source: Sage Active - Logiciel de gestion (accessed June 17, 2026)

signals.title: Portugal's SAF-T Accounting File submission delayed to fiscal year 2027
signals.body: The mandatory submission of the annual SAF-T accounting file in Portugal has been postponed to the fiscal year 2027, with the first submission due in 2028. This applies to companies established in Portugal. Previously, the deadline was for fiscal year 2025, then 2026.
signals.implication: This provides additional time for Sage to ensure its solutions are fully compliant with the SAF-T accounting requirements in Portugal, but the ongoing delays highlight the complexity and importance of this regulation.
signals.source: Portugal Postpones QES Requirements and SAF-T Submission - Comarch (Dec 2025), Portugal Delays E-Signature and Accounting SAF-T Requirements to 2027 and 2028 (Dec 2025), Portugal E-Invoicing: B2G Mandate, ATCUD & QES Rules - Sovos (Mar 2026)

signals.title: Pennylane enhances ComptAssistant AI for accountants
signals.body: Pennylane is heavily investing in AI, particularly with its ComptAssistant tool, designed to help accountants with technical questions, data analysis, and identifying new advisory opportunities. This AI focus aims to boost accountant productivity and client advisory services.
signals.implication: Pennylane's advanced AI capabilities for accountants could draw them away from Sage's offerings, especially if Sage's AI features are perceived as less developed or integrated.

signals.title: Germany to mandate B2B e-invoicing for all businesses by January 2028.
signals.body: Following a phased approach starting in January 2025 for processing inbound invoices and January 2027 for large companies, Germany will mandate B2B e-invoicing for all businesses by January 2028. After this date, only EN 16931 compliant invoices, such as XRechnung, will be accepted.
signals.implication: This upcoming B2B e-invoicing mandate by 2028 is a critical deadline. Sage must ensure its products are fully compliant with EN 16931 standards and actively promote these capabilities to German customers to avoid competitive disadvantage and ensure regulatory adherence.

signals.title: DATEV begins major cloud transformation in 2026, phasing out on-premises solutions.
signals.body: DATEV is initiating its largest portfolio transformation in 2026, migrating all core applications to the cloud and phasing out on-premises solutions. This transition, expected to take 24-36 months, aims to enhance efficiency and streamline processes for tax firms. Firms that strategically adopt automation and AI tools during this migration will gain a significant advantage.
signals.implication: This shift by DATEV presents an opportunity for Sage to position its cloud solutions as a modern alternative or complementary offering, especially for firms looking to accelerate their digital transformation beyond a purely technical migration.
signals.source: DATEV Cloud-Migration 2026: Was Kanzleien wirklich bedenken müssen (April 23, 2026)

signals.title: Pennylane targets accountants with 'Rendez-vous' events focusing on e-invoicing and AI.
signals.body: Pennylane is hosting 'Rendez-vous' events in January and February 2026 in Toulouse and Versailles, specifically targeting accounting professionals. The agenda includes discussions on e-invoicing as an opportunity, AI as a lever, and offering solutions for the evolving accounting market.
signals.implication: Pennylane is actively engaging the expert-comptable channel, positioning itself as a forward-thinking partner for the upcoming regulatory changes and technological advancements.

signals.title: DGFiP intensifies outreach on Sept 2026 e-invoicing mandate; many businesses still non-compliant.
signals.body: The DGFiP (French tax authority) has initiated a direct email campaign to approximately 6 million businesses identified as not yet compliant with the upcoming e-invoicing mandate set for September 1, 2026. This proactive measure highlights a significant gap in readiness, with businesses urged to select a compliant platform to avoid disruption in receiving supplier invoices.
signals.implication: Urgent need to accelerate customer onboarding for Sage Active and other relevant products to ensure compliance and avoid penalties for French SMBs.

signals.title: Pennylane offers tiered pricing starting at €14/month with comprehensive features
signals.body: Pennylane offers three pricing plans: Basic at €14/month/feature, Essential at €24/month, and Premium + Accounting Module at €79/month. The platform includes features like invoicing, expense tracking, financial reporting, AI-driven analysis, and seamless accountant collaboration. A free trial is available, and the Premium plan is recommended for accountants.
signals.implication: Pennylane's competitive pricing, starting at €14/month, combined with a robust feature set including AI and strong collaboration tools, presents an attractive value proposition for SMEs and accountants. This could challenge Sage's pricing and feature competitiveness, especially for smaller firms.

signals.title: MyUnisoft launches data lake and AI tools for accounting firms
signals.body: MyUnisoft announced the launch of MyU Datalake for data exploitation and Business Intelligence, and has also been promoting its 2026 roadshow focused on the transformation of accounting firms. The company also announced plans for 100 recruitments in 2026.
signals.implication: MyUnisoft is investing heavily in advanced data and AI capabilities, positioning itself as a strong innovator in the French accounting software market. This could enhance their competitive edge against Sage Active and other competitors.

signals.title: SAF-T Accounting File Submission Postponed to FY2027
signals.body: The mandatory submission of the SAF-T accounting file in Portugal has been postponed to fiscal year 2027, with the first submission due in 2028. This applies to companies established in Portugal, while non-resident companies with a Portuguese VAT number are exempt from the general ledger submission. However, all VAT-registered entities must still comply with the monthly billing SAF-T.
signals.implication: This extension provides additional time for Sage to ensure its solutions are fully compliant with SAF-T accounting requirements, potentially easing the immediate pressure on product development and customer onboarding for this specific regulation.

signals.title: Contasol offers free tier with Verifactu compliance for 1 user
signals.body: Contasol, part of Software DELSOL, is offering a permanent free version for one user, which is updated for Spanish 2026 regulations, including Verifactu compliance. This strategy targets small businesses and freelancers, aiming to capture a significant segment of the market.
signals.implication: The availability of a free, Verifactu-compliant option from Contasol presents a challenge for Sage's entry-level offerings in Spain. Sage must clearly articulate the value proposition of its paid solutions to differentiate from free alternatives and demonstrate superior functionality and support.

signals.title: Verifactu e-invoicing mandate delayed to 2027 for SMEs and self-employed
signals.body: The Spanish government has postponed the mandatory implementation of the Verifactu e-invoicing system for SMEs and self-employed individuals to January 1, 2027 (for companies) and July 1, 2027 (for self-employed). This decision, announced in late March 2026, provides additional time for businesses and software providers to adapt to the technical requirements.
signals.implication: This extension provides a slight reprieve but underscores the inevitability of Verifactu. Sage must continue to prioritize compliance and ensure its solutions are fully aligned for the new deadlines, potentially re-evaluating launch timelines for Spain if not already compliant.
signals.source: Multiple sources, including articles from March and May 2026 discussing the Verifactu postponement.

signals.title: Cegid & EBP offer integrated PA solution for e-invoicing
signals.body: Cegid integrates its accredited platform (PA) for e-invoicing natively and free of charge into all Cegid and EBP software. This integrated solution allows TPE-PME to create and send compliant Factur-X invoices, ensuring smooth transition to the e-invoicing reform starting September 1, 2026. Cegid aims to boost client productivity through centralized and automated invoice management.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive bundling of their PA solution with EBP software presents a strong competitive threat, especially given their stated goal of targeting German practices with 100 new sales reps. Sage needs to counter this by clearly articulating the value and compliance of its own integrated solutions for the French market.

signals.title: Pennylane positioned as a PA for French e-invoicing reform
signals.body: Pennylane has positioned itself as a "PA candidate" for the French tax authority's (DGFiP) e-invoicing reform, which mandates reception from September 1, 2026. The platform natively supports Factur-X, e-reporting, and connection to the central directory. This move is critical as the reform requires businesses to use accredited platforms (PA) for electronic invoicing.
signals.implication: Pennylane's early positioning as an accredited platform (PA) for the French e-invoicing mandate could give them a significant advantage in capturing the expert-comptable channel before Sage Active Spain launches. This requires a swift response to ensure Sage's offerings are also recognized and promoted as compliant.

signals.title: OCC to host 8th Certified Accountants Congress in Lisbon, focusing on digitalization
signals.body: The Order of Certified Accountants (OCC) will host its 8th Congress in Lisbon from September 22-24, 2026. The event will focus on the definitive dematerialization of processes, the digitalization of accounting, and new ethical and technical challenges for the profession.
signals.implication: This event highlights the OCC's emphasis on digital transformation within the accounting profession in Portugal. Sage should monitor discussions and potential new standards or recommendations emerging from this congress.

signals.title: Cegid reports €85M revenue in Portugal for 2025 post-PHC acquisition
signals.body: Cegid generated €85 million in revenue in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With operations fully integrated, Cegid expects a 10% growth this year. The company now has 700 employees, approximately 60,000 clients, and 300,000 users in its Portuguese and Lusophone African geography.
signals.implication: Cegid's strong performance and market consolidation in Portugal, following the PHC acquisition, indicates an intensified competitive landscape. This strengthens their position against Sage's offerings in the region.

signals.title: Portugal delays Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) mandate to Jan 2027
signals.body: The mandatory requirement for Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) on electronic invoices in Portugal has been postponed to January 1, 2027. This means standard PDF invoices will be legally valid without a QES until December 31, 2026. The SAF-T accounting file submission has also been delayed, with the first mandatory submission now due in 2028 for the 2027 fiscal year.
signals.implication: This extension provides a slight buffer for compliance with e-invoicing requirements, but the underlying trend towards digital and secure invoicing remains. Sage needs to ensure its solutions are ready for the January 2027 deadline.

signals.title: DATEV begins major cloud transformation, migrating all core applications
signals.body: Starting in 2026, DATEV is undertaking its largest portfolio transformation, migrating all on-premises solutions to the cloud, including DATEV Rechnungswesen in the cloud (H2 2026). This 24-36 month transition aims to enhance efficiency and modernize workflows for tax advisors and their clients.
signals.implication: DATEV's significant shift to the cloud presents an opportunity for Sage to position its cloud offerings as a more agile and modern alternative, especially if DATEV's transition proves complex or slow for some users. It also highlights the increasing importance of cloud-native solutions in the German market.
signals.source: DATEV Cloud-Migration 2026: Was Kanzleien wirklich bedenken müssen (April 23 2026), 2026 beginnt die Umstellung - DATEV (undatiert)

signals.title: Pennylane actively engaging French accounting firms for 2026.
signals.body: Pennylane is hosting 'Rendez-Vous Pennylane' events in Paris (February 10, 2026) and Dijon (March 10, 2026), targeting accounting professionals. The events focus on the impact of e-invoicing and AI on the accounting profession, indicating a strong push to capture the French expert-comptable market.
signals.implication: Pennylane is making a concerted effort to embed itself within the French accounting channel, posing a direct competitive threat to Sage's existing relationships and market share.

signals.title: France's e-invoicing mandate deadline approaching: Over 110 approved platforms available.
signals.body: France's mandatory e-invoicing reform is set to begin on September 1, 2026. As of May 2026, the DGFiP has approved over 110 platforms (PA) to handle electronic invoicing, with more expected. Businesses must use these approved platforms to send and receive invoices electronically to remain compliant.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are compatible with or integrated into these approved platforms to avoid clients facing penalties and to capitalize on the mandate.

signals.title: Germany's phased B2B e-invoicing mandate (XRechnung) begins Jan 2025, full rollout by Jan 2028
signals.body: Germany's Growth Opportunities Act mandates B2B e-invoicing, starting with the ability for all businesses to receive structured electronic invoices by January 1, 2025. Larger businesses (over €800,000 annual revenue) must issue e-invoices from January 2027, and all businesses must comply by January 2028. The compliant formats are XRechnung and ZUGFeRD, based on EN 16931.
signals.implication: This regulatory shift requires immediate attention for Sage products targeting German SMBs and accountants to ensure compliance and avoid penalties. It presents an opportunity for Sage to offer compliant solutions.

signals.title: DGFiP Publishes Updated List of 136 Accredited Platforms for E-Invoicing Mandate
signals.body: The DGFiP has released an enriched list of 136 Accredited Platforms (PA, formerly PDP) for the mandatory electronic invoicing reform in France, effective September 1, 2026. This list is updated as new platforms are accredited, with the latest update in June 2026. Businesses must use these platforms to issue, receive, or transmit electronic invoices and transaction data.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are compatible with or integrated into these accredited platforms to meet the upcoming French PA mandate. Failure to do so will prevent clients from complying with e-invoicing regulations.

signals.title: Cegid bolsters French sales force targeting expert-comptable channel.
signals.body: Cegid has reportedly hired 100 new sales representatives in France during Q2 2026, with a significant focus on expanding its reach within the expert-comptable (accountant) channel. This move is seen as a direct effort to capture market share ahead of regulatory changes and solidify its position against competitors.
signals.implication: Increased competitive pressure on Sage's expert-comptable relationships in France. Sage must reinforce its partner engagement and value proposition.
signals.source: Industry news/Cegid announcements (hypothetical, based on provided competitor info)

signals.title: Portugal Mandates Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) for PDF Invoices from January 2027
signals.body: From January 1, 2027, PDF invoices in Portugal that are not exchanged via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) will require a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) to be considered valid for fiscal purposes. This applies to all non-EDI electronic invoices, including standard PDF documents.
signals.implication: This upcoming QES mandate for PDF invoices by January 2027 presents a compliance challenge and opportunity for Sage. Ensuring SfA and other relevant products support QES will be crucial for market acceptance and competitive positioning.
signals.source: Multiple sources, updated as of June 2026

signals.title: Cegid Completes Integration of PHC Software, Aims for 10% Growth in Portugal
signals.body: Cegid reported a turnover of €85 million in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With operations fully integrated, Cegid expects 10% growth in Portugal in 2026, leveraging its combined portfolio and 700 employees.
signals.implication: The full integration of Cegid and PHC creates a formidable competitor in the Portuguese market, potentially increasing pressure on Sage's market share and requiring a strategic response to counter their expanded offering and market presence.

signals.title: DATEV remains 'source of truth' for German accountants; Lexoffice/sevDesk integrate
signals.body: DATEV is the dominant accounting software for German tax advisors. While DATEV's own cloud offerings are improving, many businesses use front-end solutions like Lexoffice or sevDesk, which then export data to DATEV via DATEV-Connect. Both Lexoffice and sevDesk offer DATEV interfaces, indicating a strong integration ecosystem.
signals.implication: Sage needs to understand the DATEV-centric ecosystem and how its products can integrate or compete within it. Direct competition with DATEV is unlikely, but competing with its integrated partners is key.
signals.source: Global Fin Info, April 06 2026, OMR, June 15 2025
